reasoning: External attackers can reach internal crown-jewel data stores via internet-facing assets running vulnerable software. We prioritize and fix findings on these internet-exposed assets that have known exploitation (KEV) and critical CVSS scores to sever all incoming attack paths.

FROM findings f
JOIN edges e1 ON e1.dst = f.id AND e1.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e1.src = a.id
JOIN edges e2 ON e2.src = software.id -- wait, need proper joins for findings -> software -> vuln -> asset -> reachability -> datastore

input.sql:
SELECT f.id as finding, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, a.id as asset_id, a.hostname
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = s.id AND hv.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20

SELECT f.id as finding, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, a.hostname, ex.type as exposure
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = s.id AND hv.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.src = 'internet'
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 30

SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.hostname, ex.props->'port' as port
FROM assets a
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.src = 'internet'

SELECT f.id as finding, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, a.hostname
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = s.id AND hv.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.src = 'internet'
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC
LIMIT 20
